AssisT is a free, open-source Chrome extension built for neurodivergent students.
Install free: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/assist-adaptive-augmentat/dkekfjomoacmhbkekjkngmpbdlljjfhi
GitHub: https://github.com/FiavaionDev/assist

#AssisT #AccessibilityTools #ChromeExtension #CanvasLMS #Dyslexia #Neurodivergent

panels.title: AssisT — Install | Free Accessibility Tool for Canvas
panels.shortDesc: Add AssisT to Chrome from the Web Store in under a minute
panels.description:
Install AssisT on Chrome in under 60 seconds. AssisT is a free, open-source accessibility extension for neurodivergent students using Canvas, Moodle, and Google Classroom.

0:00 Installing AssisT from the Chrome Web Store
0:05 Demo

panels.title: AssisT — First Setup | Free Accessibility Tool for Canvas
panels.shortDesc: Open the popup, try Read Aloud, and configure your preferences
panels.description:
Open the AssisT popup for the first time, try Read Aloud, and set your preferences. Get up and running in under two minutes.

0:00 Opening AssisT for the first time
0:05 Demo

panels.title: AssisT — Browser AI Setup | No API Key Needed
panels.shortDesc: Run AI privately in Chrome with no account or API key
panels.description:
Learn how to set up Browser AI mode in AssisT — the easiest way to add AI features to your studies without an API key or external account.

In this video:
→ How to access the AI Setup wizard
→ Running the system scan to find your best AI option
→ Choosing and downloading a browser AI model
→ Setting your response preferences (length, reading level, learning style)
→ Verifying your AI is working

Browser AI runs entirely inside Chrome — your data never leaves your device, making it a strong privacy-first choice for students.

Note: Browser AI is the most accessible option to set up, but for better speed and accuracy, see the Local AI (Ollama) setup guide linked below.

─────────────────────────────
🔗 AssisT AI Setup Guides:
• Browser AI (this video)
• Local AI (Ollama) → [link]
• Cloud AI (Gemini & Claude) → [link]
  Gemini free API key: https://aistudio.google.com/apikey
  Anthropic API key: https://console.anthropic.com/settings/keys

📥 Install AssisT free:
https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/assist-adaptive-augmentat/dkekfjomoacmhbkekjkngmpbdlljjfhi

🦙 Download Ollama (for Local AI mode):
https://ollama.com
─────────────────────────────

panels.title: AssisT — Local AI Setup with Ollama | Fast, Private, Offline
panels.shortDesc: Full privacy and offline AI using Ollama on your own machine
panels.description:
Learn how to set up Local AI mode in AssisT using Ollama — the fastest private AI option, running entirely on your own machine with no cloud account needed.

In this video:
→ Installing Ollama on your system
→ Pulling a model in the terminal
→ Running the AI Setup wizard in AssisT
→ Selecting your Ollama model
→ Verifying your AI is working

Local AI with Ollama is faster than Browser AI and works fully offline once the model is downloaded. Your data never leaves your machine.

─────────────────────────────

─────────────────────────────

panels.title: AssisT — Cloud AI Setup | Gemini Free & Anthropic Claude
panels.shortDesc: Most capable AI — set up Gemini (free) or Anthropic Claude
panels.description:
Learn how to set up Cloud AI mode in AssisT using Google Gemini (free tier) or Anthropic Claude — the most capable AI option for summarisation, study planning, and knowledge graphs.

In this video:
→ Getting a free Gemini API key from Google AI Studio
→ Getting an Anthropic Claude API key
→ Entering and verifying your key in the AI Setup wizard
→ Setting your response preferences
→ Verifying your AI is working

Cloud AI gives you access to the most powerful models. Gemini has a free tier with no payment required. Anthropic Claude offers free credits on sign-up.

─────────────────────────────
🔗 AssisT AI Setup Guides:
• Browser AI → [link]
• Local AI (Ollama) → [link]

https://ollama.com

panels.title: AssisT — Read Aloud | Free Accessibility Tool for Canvas
panels.shortDesc: Text-to-speech with word highlighting
panels.description:
Read Aloud reads any text on Canvas aloud with word-by-word highlighting. Choose your voice, speed, and pitch — all client-side, no data leaves your browser.

0:00 Activating Read Aloud on Canvas
0:05 Demo

panels.title: AssisT — Reading Mode | Free Accessibility Tool for Canvas
panels.shortDesc: Distraction-free reading view using Mozilla Readability
panels.description:
Reading Mode strips away navigation, sidebars, and clutter and presents only the page content in a clean, readable layout using Mozilla Readability.

0:00 Activating Reading Mode
0:05 Demo

panels.title: AssisT — Dyslexia Mode | Free Accessibility Tool for Canvas
panels.shortDesc: Bionic reading, syllable colour-coding, grammar colours
panels.description:
Dyslexia Mode applies bionic reading (bold first letters), syllable colour-coding, and grammar colour-coding to improve reading fluency and reduce cognitive load.

0:00 Enabling Dyslexia Mode
0:05 Demo

panels.title: AssisT — OCR | Free Accessibility Tool for Canvas
panels.shortDesc: Text extraction from images, screenshots, and PDFs
panels.description:
OCR (Optical Character Recognition) extracts text from images, screenshots, and PDFs directly in the browser — making visual content accessible without leaving Canvas.

0:00 Using OCR on an image
0:05 Demo

panels.title: AssisT — Speech to Text | Free Accessibility Tool for Canvas
panels.shortDesc: Voice-based text input for any text field
panels.description:
Speech to Text activates voice input for any text field on Canvas — type assignments, forum posts, and quizzes by speaking. Uses the Web Speech API, fully on-device.

0:00 Activating Speech to Text
0:05 Demo

panels.title: AssisT — Quick Actions Menu | Free Accessibility Tool for Canvas
panels.shortDesc: Floating toolbar on text selection for instant access
panels.description:
Select any text on Canvas and a floating Quick Actions toolbar appears instantly — giving you one-click access to Read Aloud, Dictionary, Translation, and more.

0:00 Selecting text to open Quick Actions
0:05 Demo

panels.title: AssisT — Dictionary | Free Accessibility Tool for Canvas
panels.shortDesc: Word definitions, pronunciations, and usage examples
panels.description:
Select any word and get instant definitions, pronunciation audio, part of speech, and usage examples — without leaving Canvas or opening a new tab.

0:00 Looking up a word with AssisT Dictionary
0:05 Demo

panels.title: AssisT — Translation | Free Accessibility Tool for Canvas
panels.shortDesc: Full-page and selected text translation in 14+ languages
panels.description:
Translate entire pages or selected text into 14+ languages directly inside Canvas. Supports multilingual students without disrupting the page layout.

0:00 Translating a Canvas page
0:05 Demo

panels.title: AssisT — Text Customisation | Free Accessibility Tool for Canvas
panels.shortDesc: Font, size, line spacing, letter and word spacing
panels.description:
Customise font family, size, line height, letter spacing, and word spacing across Canvas — fully compliant with WCAG 2.2 Success Criterion 1.4.12 Text Spacing.

0:00 Adjusting text spacing in AssisT
0:05 Demo

panels.title: AssisT — Reading Guide | Free Accessibility Tool for Canvas
panels.shortDesc: Mouse-tracking guide line for focus and tracking support
panels.description:
A horizontal guide line follows your cursor as you read, helping students with tracking difficulties, ADHD, and visual impairments stay on the correct line.

0:00 Enabling the Reading Guide
0:05 Demo

panels.title: AssisT — Reading Progress | Free Accessibility Tool for Canvas
panels.shortDesc: Visual scroll progress bar for long documents
panels.description:
A subtle progress bar at the top of the page shows how far through a document you are — helpful for long Canvas pages, assignments, and readings.

0:00 Enabling Reading Progress
0:05 Demo

panels.title: AssisT — Speed Read (RSVP) | Free Accessibility Tool for Canvas
panels.shortDesc: Rapid serial visual presentation with pivot-letter highlighting
panels.description:
Speed Read uses Rapid Serial Visual Presentation (RSVP) to display text one word at a time at a speed you set, with a highlighted pivot letter for fast tracking.

0:00 Using Speed Read on Canvas content
0:05 Demo

panels.title: AssisT — Annotations | Free Accessibility Tool for Canvas
panels.shortDesc: Inline and sidebar annotations with export and import
panels.description:
Highlight and annotate any text on Canvas with colour-coded inline highlights and sidebar notes. Export as JSON or import annotations shared by others.

0:00 Adding annotations to a Canvas page
0:05 Demo

panels.title: AssisT — Sticky Notes | Free Accessibility Tool for Canvas
panels.shortDesc: Colour-coded persistent notes attached to pages
panels.description:
Attach colour-coded sticky notes to any Canvas page — they persist across sessions and reload automatically when you return to the same URL.

0:00 Creating a sticky note on Canvas
0:05 Demo

panels.title: AssisT — Custom Cursor | Free Accessibility Tool for Canvas
panels.shortDesc: Large, high-contrast cursor styles for improved visibility
panels.description:
Replace the default cursor with large, high-contrast cursor styles — helpful for users with low vision, motor difficulties, or anyone who loses the cursor on busy pages.

0:00 Switching to a custom cursor
0:05 Demo

panels.title: AssisT — Magnifying Lens | Free Accessibility Tool for Canvas
panels.shortDesc: Cursor-following magnification lens, 1.5×–4×
panels.description:
A circular magnifying lens follows your cursor and magnifies content at 1.5× to 4× zoom — no browser zoom setting changes required, works at the element level.

0:00 Enabling the Magnifying Lens
0:05 Demo

panels.title: AssisT — Focus Mode | Free Accessibility Tool for Canvas
panels.shortDesc: Dark overlay with a clear reading window following the cursor
panels.description:
Focus Mode dims the entire page and creates a transparent reading window that follows your cursor — reducing visual distraction for ADHD and sensory-sensitive users.

0:00 Activating Focus Mode
0:05 Demo

panels.title: AssisT — Screen Colour Overlay | Free Accessibility Tool for Canvas
panels.shortDesc: Tinted screen overlay for visual stress and eye strain reduction
panels.description:
Apply a tinted colour overlay to any Canvas page to reduce visual stress (Meares-Irlen syndrome) and eye strain. Choose from preset colours or dial in a custom tint.

0:00 Applying a colour overlay
0:05 Demo

panels.title: AssisT — Reduced Motion | Free Accessibility Tool for Canvas
panels.shortDesc: Suppress animations across all websites visited
panels.description:
Reduced Motion suppresses animations, transitions, and parallax effects site-wide — essential for users with vestibular disorders or motion sensitivity.

0:00 Enabling Reduced Motion
0:05 Demo

panels.title: AssisT — Pomodoro Timer | Free Accessibility Tool for Canvas
panels.shortDesc: Floating timer widget with customisable work and break durations
panels.description:
A floating Pomodoro timer widget sits on top of Canvas, helping students with ADHD and executive function difficulties manage study sessions with structured work/break cycles.

0:00 Starting a Pomodoro session
0:05 Demo

panels.title: AssisT — Simplified Interface | Free Accessibility Tool for Canvas
panels.shortDesc: Suppress ads, sidebars, and non-content elements
panels.description:
Simplified Interface hides ads, sidebars, decorative images, and non-essential UI elements — reducing cognitive load and visual clutter on busy pages.

0:00 Activating Simplified Interface
0:05 Demo

panels.title: AssisT — Citations | Free Accessibility Tool for Canvas
panels.shortDesc: Save and manage citations with bibliography export
panels.description:
Save citations from any webpage with one click, manage your bibliography, and export in APA, MLA, or Harvard format — all from within Canvas.

0:00 Saving a citation from a webpage
0:05 Demo

panels.title: AssisT — Canvas LMS | Free Accessibility Tool for Canvas
panels.shortDesc: Assignment reader and quiz helper for Canvas
panels.description:
AssisT's Canvas-specific features include an assignment reader that formats briefs accessibly, a quiz helper that reads questions aloud, and automatic content detection.

0:00 AssisT features specific to Canvas LMS
0:05 Demo

panels.title: AssisT — Moodle LMS | Free Accessibility Tool for Canvas
panels.shortDesc: Assignment, forum, and page readers for Moodle
panels.description:
AssisT works on Moodle too — with dedicated readers for assignments, forum posts, and course pages, helping students access content more easily.

0:00 Using AssisT on a Moodle course
0:05 Demo

panels.title: AssisT — Google Classroom | Free Accessibility Tool for Canvas
panels.shortDesc: Assignment, stream, and classwork readers
panels.description:
AssisT extends to Google Classroom — reading assignments, streams, and classwork aloud, with all accessibility features active on Google Classroom pages.

0:00 Using AssisT in Google Classroom
0:05 Demo

panels.title: AssisT — AI Summarisation | Free Accessibility Tool for Canvas
panels.shortDesc: AI-powered concise summary of selected text
panels.description:
Select any text on Canvas and get an AI-generated summary — works with local AI (Ollama), WebLLM (in-browser), or cloud AI. No data leaves your device with local or WebLLM modes.

0:00 Summarising Canvas content with AI
0:05 Demo

panels.title: AssisT — AI Text Simplification | Free Accessibility Tool for Canvas
panels.shortDesc: Semantic rewriting for accessibility and clarity
panels.description:
AI Text Simplification rewrites complex academic text into plain language — maintaining meaning while reducing reading difficulty for students with literacy or processing differences.

0:00 Simplifying text with AI
0:05 Demo

panels.title: AssisT — AI Assignment Breakdown | Free Accessibility Tool for Canvas
panels.shortDesc: Convert assignment briefs to structured task checklists
panels.description:
Paste an assignment brief and AI breaks it down into a clear, numbered checklist of tasks — helping students with executive function difficulties plan their work.

0:00 Breaking down an assignment with AI
0:05 Demo

panels.title: AssisT — AI Socratic Tutor | Free Accessibility Tool for Canvas
panels.shortDesc: Generate thought-provoking questions to deepen understanding
panels.description:
The Socratic Tutor generates questions from selected text, guiding students to deeper understanding through enquiry rather than passive reading — ideal for active recall.

0:00 Using the Socratic Tutor on study material
0:05 Demo

panels.title: AssisT — AI Knowledge Graph | Free Accessibility Tool for Canvas
panels.shortDesc: Visualise concepts and relationships as interactive nodes
panels.description:
The Knowledge Graph visualises concepts from selected text as interactive nodes and edges — helping visual learners and students with working memory difficulties see how ideas connect.

0:00 Generating a knowledge graph
0:05 Demo

panels.title: AssisT — AI Study Path Generator | Free Accessibility Tool for Canvas
panels.shortDesc: Personalised learning sequences with prerequisite mapping
panels.description:
The Study Path Generator creates a personalised learning sequence from selected content — mapping prerequisites and suggesting an order that builds knowledge progressively.

0:00 Generating a study path
0:05 Demo

panels.title: AssisT — AI Citation Analyser | Free Accessibility Tool for Canvas
panels.shortDesc: AI source credibility, bias detection, and key claims
panels.description:
The Citation Analyser assesses source credibility, detects potential bias, and extracts key claims from academic sources — supporting critical reading and research literacy.

0:00 Analysing a source with AI
0:05 Demo

panels.title: AssisT — AI Multi-Doc Compare | Free Accessibility Tool for Canvas
panels.shortDesc: AI comparison of multiple texts for overlaps and differences
panels.description:
Multi-Doc Compare uses AI to compare two or more texts — highlighting overlaps, contradictions, and unique arguments. Ideal for literature reviews and comparative essays.

0:00 Comparing documents with AI
0:05 Demo
